rule: A claim maps to a Pest test (file and exact test name) whose body checks the claim, or to a manifest subcase whose requirement covers it. Unmapped claims are gaps.

creates a saved task and returns JSON without starting a run

claims.note: The prompt the test asserts is 'Which files may Molly change?'; docs/getting-started.md line 192 says 'Which other files may Molly change?'.

claims.text: molly:start asks the model for a change, checks scope, applies it, runs the required Pest test, runs the seven Tarpit checks, and records Clever measurements before and after

tests.name: uses Laravel AI decide when Jev is enabled but never upgrades a failed run
